reviews.shade: UNOVE No Wash Water Ampoule Treatment 200ml Special Set (+50ml)
reviews.text: J’ai bien reçu les deux flacons, l’odeur est agréable, ça adoucit les cheveux, je n’ai pas encore essayé ça comme protecteur de chaleur avant un séchage ou sèche-cheveux, mais vu la texture je pense que ça sera très efficace. Si je peux revenir faire un commentaire après trois mois d’utilisation, et après avoir utilisé ça comme protecteur de chaleur, je reviendrai faire un autre retour.
reviews.zh: 兩支樽都已經收到，味道幾舒服，搽落令頭髮變軟。我未試過喺吹乾或者用吹風機之前，用佢做隔熱保護，不過睇個質地，我諗效果會好好。如果用咗三個月，而且試過用佢做隔熱保護之後，我可以返嚟再評論一次。

reviews.shade: UNOVE No Wash Water Ampoule Treatment 200ml Special Set (+50ml)
reviews.text: I cannot stress enough how amazing this product is. I couldn’t wash my hair for a whole week and this kept the frizz off, hydrated it and kept it light. Highly hydrating and moisturising without the heavy weight. Other products leave your hair greasy - this one doesn’t even if you overdo it.
reviews.zh: 我真心話呢款產品有幾好都講唔盡。我成個星期都冇洗頭，但係用咗呢款之後，毛躁都冇咗，頭髮保持輕盈。保濕力好強，唔會感覺好重身。其他產品會令頭髮油膩，呢款就算用多咗都唔會。

reviews.shade: UNOVE No Wash Water Ampoule Treatment 200ml Special Set (+50ml)
reviews.text:
This ampoule made my hair soft and easy to brush after shower. It has a strong fragrance, but it wears off and after time it’s not that noticeable on dry hair. 

A little goes a long way with this one, so do not spray this more than a few times at a time. Otherwise it can make your hair look greasy.
reviews.zh:
呢支安瓶令我洗完澡之後頭髮變得柔軟，梳落易梳。佢嘅味道好濃，不過會慢慢散走，時間一長，喺乾頭髮上就唔係咁明顯。

呢款少少已經好夠用，所以每次唔好噴多過幾下。否則，頭髮可能會睇落油膩。

reviews.shade: UNOVE No Wash Water Ampoule Treatment 200ml Special Set (+50ml)
reviews.text: Me gustó mucho, no se siente para nada como agua, es más bien como un aceite en spray para aplicarlo cuando tengas el pelo húmedo y te lo vayas a secar y te deje esa sensación sedosa y suave en tu pelo, es nada más de saber usar bien el spray porque si no te puede pasar como a mí que llene mi lavamanos con aceite por no atinarle a mi pelo jaja, el olor es a flores con ese aroma a perfume muy lindo y limpio, para nosotras la girls 🤭
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意，完全唔似水，反而似一支噴霧式嘅護髮油，喺頭髮濕濕嗰陣噴，之後吹乾，就會有絲滑柔順嘅感覺。只要識得正確咁用噴霧就得，因為如果唔啱，就可能好似我咁，我將面盆都整到係油，因為冇噴準我嘅頭髮，哈哈。味道係花香，好似香水咁，好靚、好清新，我哋呢啲女仔一定鍾意 🤭

reviews.shade: UNOVE No Wash Water Ampoule Treatment 200ml Special Set (+50ml)
reviews.text: Very easy to use with the spray bottle, it is good to spray on semi-dried hair to smooth it and make it easier to comb. However I personally found the scent too strong and cloying (it is stronger than the light pink bottle) and I had to hold my breath whilst I sprayed it thus I ended up giving this to my Mum to use instead.
reviews.zh: 用噴霧瓶好方便，喺半乾嘅頭髮上噴少少，可以令頭髮順滑啲，梳落易啲。不過我自己覺得味道太濃、太膩（比淺粉色瓶嗰款仲要濃），噴嗰陣我要屏住氣，所以最後將呢支轉俾我媽媽用。

reviews.shade: UNOVE No Wash Water Ampoule Treatment 200ml Special Set (+50ml)
reviews.text: Если вы чувствительны к запахам то не берите этот продукт так как запах очень навязчивый и не приятный. Можно найти качественнее маску, лечение для волос
reviews.zh: 如果你對氣味敏感，就唔好買呢款產品，因為味道好霸道，亦都唔好聞。可以搵質素更好嘅護髮膜或者護髮療程。

reviews.shade: UNOVE No Wash Water Ampoule Treatment 200ml Special Set (+50ml)
reviews.text: I love to apply this ampoule into my hair right after taking a shower, it INSTANTLY softens my hair! I will say to spray lightly as this can make your hair oily quickly if you apply too much. I use the entire UNOVE line, and these product all work so well together and give you salon quality results.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意洗完澡之後即刻將呢支安瓶噴喺頭髮上，即刻就令頭髮軟咗！我要講，噴嗰陣要輕啲，因為如果用太多，頭髮好快就會出油。我用晒整個 UNOVE 系列，呢啲產品一齊用效果都好好，好似髮廊級嘅專業效果咁。

reviews.shade: UNOVE No Wash Water Ampoule Treatment 200ml Special Set (+50ml)
reviews.text: Smells nice but it can be a little strong when you first spray it. The scent wears off after a while and has a nicer/lighter smell. It does soften your hair but it can be quite messy. Especially the 50mL bottle!! I recommend using the 200mL bottle first and once you have gone through some of the product, pour in the 50mL in the the big bottle.
reviews.zh: 味道幾好聞，但係一開始噴嗰陣可能有少少濃。過一段時間味道會散去，變得更加清淡舒服。佢確實可以令頭髮變軟，但係用起嚟可能會好亂，尤其係 50mL 嗰支！我建議先用 200mL 嗰支，用咗一部分之後，就將 50mL 嗰支嘅產品倒入大支嗰支度。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
